summary: Transforms a 3-component source vector at a2 through a 3x4 matrix at a3 and stores the resulting 3-component vector at a1. Matrix pointer alignment (a3 & 0xF) selects between unaligned 8-byte half-row loads and aligned __m128 row loads; both branches compute the same x*row0 + y*row1 + z*row2 combination. Returns a1, the destination vector.

operations.description: Dispatch on matrix pointer alignment: when (a3 & 0xF) != 0 the matrix rows are loaded as 8-byte halves, otherwise rows are read as aligned 16-byte __m128 values at offsets 0, 16, 32.
Broadcast each source component from a2 (x and y from the low 8 bytes, z from offset 8) and multiply each broadcast by the corresponding 16-byte matrix row to build the three row contributions.
Sum the three row contributions to form the transformed vector: x*row0 + y*row1 + z*row2.
Write the result to a1: the low 8 bytes hold the first two components and the upper 4 bytes at a1+8 hold the third component.
Return a1, the destination vector pointer.
Legacy ABI name 'SSE_3x4_Matrix_Vector_Transform' is retained as the identity signal for this entry; it does not claim an owner object.
